basic_details.job_title: DGFT Young Professional (YP) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Joint Director General of Foreign Trade, Indore/Bhopal (Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India) has invited applications for three Young Professional (YP) posts on a contract basis: 2 at RA Indore and 1 at RA Bhopal. The consolidated fee is Rs.56000/- per month. The engagement is initially for one year and may be extended up to three years. Applicants need LLM/LLB and a PG Diploma in any legal subject (Legal), or an MBA or equivalent from an institution with NIRF ranking up to 100 in Management / Masters in Public Policy / International Trade (General Management

how_to_apply: Send the application from your valid email ID, with supporting documents, to [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026.
Write the subject of the email as: Application for Young Professional.
Fill the application form provided at the Google link mentioned in the notice. The notice says this is mandatory for all applicants.

Submit the signed application form printed in the notice. It asks for name in block letters, date of birth, gender, email ID, mobile number, residential address, educational qualification, work experience, any other information and a latest photograph. It ends with a declaration signed by the applicant.
Attach the Resume, copy of PAN card, Aadhar card and copies of relevant qualification documents.
A hard copy of the application may also be sent to: O/o Joint DGFT, BSNL Bhawan, Old CTO Compound, residency Area, Indore 452001.
Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will be rejected.
important_instructions: The engagement is subject to verification of documents related to educational qualification and experience. If any information or document is found false or wrong at any stage, the engagement will be terminated immediately and appropriate action taken as per rules. Before engagement, Young Professionals must submit a police verification medical-cum-fitness certificate issued by an authorized Medical Practitioner. The competent authority may also require a Statement of Good Health from a recognized physician before work begins. Working hours are normally 9.30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days, with half an hour lunch break at 1.30pm. In exigencies of work, Young Professionals may be required to sit late and may be called on Saturday, Sunday and other holidays. Each Young Professional is solely responsible for taking out and maintaining insurance, at his or her own expense. Young Professionals are governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923. Information, records, papers, software and emails created during the engagement are the property of Government. The name, emblem or official seal of the Government of India or DGFT/Office of Joint DGFT, or any abbreviation of the name, may not be used in connection with business or otherwise without prior written permission of the competent authority. Services can be terminated forthwith, without notice period or compensation, if found unsatisfactory or in conflict with the interest of DGFT/Government of India. The authority also reserves the right to terminate at any stage for a serious failure to perform the assigned task or to observe standards of conduct. The engagement gives no claim or right to later engagement or employment with DGFT/Office of Joint DGFT or any other Government Department. In case of death, injury or illness during service, the Young Professional or next of kin is not entitled to any compensation or Appointment.

content_sections.heading: About the Office of the Joint DGFT, Indore/Bhopal
content_sections.text: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) is an attached office of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and is headed by the Director General of Foreign Trade. It is responsible for formulating and implementing the Foreign Trade Policy and works through a network of 24 regional offices. The Regional Authorities at Indore and Bhopal act as its field offices, and the Young Professionals will work on implementation of the schemes under the Foreign Trade Policy.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces three vacancies on a contract basis. The notice does not print a separate count for each discipline.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same age limit and experience condition apply to both disciplines. The qualification differs by discipline. Experience: minimum one year post qualification experience in relevant field with proficiency in Computer skills. Age: below 40 years of age as on 01 September 2026. The notice lists no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: LLM/LLB and PG Diploma in any legal subject.
MBA or equivalent from an institution having NIRF ranking up to 100 in Management category as per the latest NIRF ranking/Masters in Public Policy/ International Trade.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: a consolidated fee of Rs.56000/- per month (minus Professional Tax/TDS as applicable), subject to periodic completion of work certified by the controlling Officer. No other allowance or facility is payable in addition to the consolidated fee. Tenure: initially one year, which may be extended up to three years. After three years no further extension is permissible under any circumstances. The engagement is purely on a temporary basis. The period of engagement commences from the date of joining at the Office of the Joint DGFT. Either side can end the engagement by giving 30 days' notice. The Department may instead give pay in lieu of notice. Leave: 18 days during one year on pro-rata basis, with prior written approval of the controlling Officer. Unavailed leave cannot be carried forward. Leave up to one month without remuneration can be considered with prior approval. Women Young Professionals may be eligible for maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. Travel: Young Professionals may be required to travel to any place in India. TA/DA is admissible as to Assistant Section Officer of the Central Government.

faq.question: Q1. How many Young Professional posts are vacant at DGFT Indore/Bhopal?

faq.answer: The application must reach [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for DGFT Young Professional?
faq.answer: For Legal: LLM/LLB and PG Diploma in any legal subject. For General Management: MBA or equivalent from an institution having NIRF ranking up to 100 in Management category as per the latest NIRF ranking/Masters in Public Policy/ International Trade. faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 40 years of age as on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a DGFT Young Professional?

faq.answer: Email your application with supporting documents to [email protected] with the subject "Application for Young Professional". Also fill the application form at the Google link mentioned in the notice and submit the signed form with your Resume, PAN card copy, Aadhar card copy and qualification documents.
